description: Synthetic owner-reference format fixtures. These are schema and workflow data, not legal-quality or procedural-eligibility verdicts.

court_facts.parties: [Applicant and responding parties, roles and addresses]
court_facts.material_facts: [User-confirmed chronology; no sample events from the reference manual]
court_facts.grounds: [Grounds supported by supplied facts and legal sources]

court_forms.injunction_breach_application: [Actual order, service or knowledge evidence, and alleged breaches]
court_forms.indigent_person_application: [Disclosed means and assets; eligibility is not presumed]
court_forms.execution_application: [Decree, parties, payment or satisfaction history, and requested mode of execution]
court_forms.restitution_conjugal_rights: [Marriage, cohabitation, alleged withdrawal and requested relief]
court_forms.judicial_separation_petition: [Marriage particulars, supplied grounds and separation relief]
court_forms.mutual_consent_divorce: [Both joint petitioners, actual consent, separation and agreed settlement particulars]
court_forms.letters_of_administration: [Deceased, applicant's basis, estate, heirs and actual will position]
court_forms.succession_certificate: [Deceased, relationship, heirs, debts and securities schedule]
court_forms.cheque_bounce_complaint: [Liability, cheque, dishonour, notice, service and payment chronology]
court_forms.maintenance_application: [Each applicant, representation, relationship, needs, income and means]
court_forms.consumer_complaint: [Transaction, grievance, communications, valuation and requested remedies]
court_forms.domestic_violence_complaint: [Relationship, household, alleged acts, evidence and each remedy requested]

legal_notice_reply.reference_document: [Actual original notice and its supplied date]
legal_notice_reply.paragraph_wise_reply: [The user's explicit admissions, denials and explanations]

deed_facts.transaction_facts: [Actual agreed transaction and background supplied by the user]
deed_facts.operative_terms: [Terms actually agreed by the parties; no presumed execution]

facts.facts_brief: Synthetic supplied chronology and requested relief only. Missing claim, property and transaction particulars remain explicit placeholders for counsel to complete.
relief_sought: [Only the relief actually instructed by the user]

facts.impugned_order_summary: [Actual impugned order, proceeding and outcome supplied by the user; no sample dispute is adopted]
facts.grounds_brief: [Grounds actually supported by the supplied record and confirmed legal sources; no entitlement, procedural compliance or legal proposition is inferred from this synthetic fixture]

facts.property_address: [Actual premises and description supplied by the user]
facts.relief_sought: [Actual possession or other demand supplied by the user; no invented breach or arrears]
facts.notice_requirements: [Confirmed termination basis, period and service requirements; not a default]

facts.impugned_action: [Actual supplied action, inaction or detention particulars]
